overview: Installs Docker Engine and Docker Compose plugin on Server B or Server C. Prompts for a Linux username to add to the docker group — no automatic user detection.
prerequisites: An existing Linux user account for Docker access

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-docker-host

steps.title: Install Docker Engine
steps.body: Prompts for username, shows what will be installed, then applies.

steps.title: Log out and back in
steps.body: The added user must start a new session for docker group membership to take effect.

commands.description: Install Docker and add user to docker group

notes: Installs docker.io and docker-compose-plugin from APT
